taste:
This burger offers a rich, savoury flavour and a dense, juicy texture, with a subtle smoky undertone from the Beyond Meat patty. Its appeal is the beef-like eating experience without a meat patty, rather than a burger centred on vegetables. The soft bun contrasts with the substantial filling, while lettuce, sliced tomato and red onion provide the fresh salad elements.

Served hot with a generous portion of chips, it follows the familiar pub burger format. Expect the patty to be the main focus of the flavour and texture. If you enjoy a savoury burger but want a plant-based option, that combination is the clearest reason to choose it.
